## Outcome

SPRINT BRIEF (phase 1, the load-bearing primitive). Give every Boreal record a machine-portable address: boreal://<project-id>/<record-id>, accepted wherever a SourceRef URI or graph-edge endpoint is accepted, resolved through the registry. Constraints from the design doc: references key on registry project id never filesystem path (survives repo moves and the multi-machine future); resolution is read-only and fail-soft - an unlinked or missing project resolves to a typed unresolved result carrying the last-known rollup snapshot, never an exception that breaks a caller; graph edges gain optional cross-project endpoint fields as an additive change. This sprint is hard-blocked on the directive hardening sprint (bw_work_3f7f260bf6186160) because it touches the same core record types that sprint is stabilizing, and on stable registry ids from sprint G1.
